messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT: autoscaler failure in cluster 'prod-inference' — node pool 'inference-prod-gpu' has hit configured max_node_count=20. Queue length: ~1200 requests, token throttling increasing, 5xx spike on inference API. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/infra/autoscale?org=prod 

mike_oncall: i'm paged, looking now. any customer impact metrics?

incident-bot: summary metrics attached — p95 latency up 3x, token retries up, 12 customers experiencing >30s tail latency.

anya_sre: @mike_oncall i'm in. first check: are we hitting cloud quota (hard limit) or our policy ceiling?

mike_oncall: quick look: autoscaler hit desired==max (20). HPA shows pending scale because pods unschedulable due to node limits. running `kubectl get nodes` shows 20 nodes full.

emma_eng: we have bursty load from a couple heavy customers (batching tests). Could route heavy traffic to fallback model 1/2 capacity?

raj_infra: tagging in infra. i'll check cloud console for quota errors and recent scale events.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary release 2026-03-15/rollout-13 not related.

mike_oncall: logs from cluster-autoscaler: `scale up rejected: reached max size` and GCP errors: `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Quota 'TPU_PER_PROJECT' exceeded` — but that's suspicious, we don't use TPU. more likely instance quota hit or ip address limits.

raj_infra: confirmed: GCE regional quota for GPUs is at account hard limit for this region. No pending quota increase. There is also a soft safety ceiling set in our terraform module at 20.

anya_sre: ok two constraints: (1) terraform safety ceiling = 20 nodes, (2) cloud GPU quota = 20. Which is blocking? if cloud quota is 20 we can't increase until quota is approved.

mike_oncall: can we do a manual override on infra side to temporarily lift safety ceiling while we request quota increase? Need approval from infra owners + SRE lead.

raj_infra: i can lift the terraform ceiling to 30 in the infra staging plan and apply a manual increase to autoscaler config but cloud quota will still block actual spinup past 20. we need cloud quota increase request — that normally takes 1-2 hours.

emma_eng: can we mitigate by routing small/fast models to CPU-backed pool to reduce GPU demand? that would drop quality for some customers but reduce queue.

mike_oncall: agree. let's enable model-fallback routing policy as emergency mitigation. @emma_eng can you push the route change?

emma_eng: on it — preparing rollback-safe change. Will flip traffic for models: "gpt-lite-7b" fallback to cpu-variant for non-enterprise customers.

sara_cust_success: flagged top impacted customers and sent heads-up note about degraded performance. asking for permission to give ETA 2-3 hours.

anya_sre: parallel tasks: (A) submit cloud quota increase (B) request infra-lead approval to bump terraform ceiling (C) enable fallback routing (D) evaluate temporary drop of batch-ingestion rate. who owns each?

mike_oncall: i'll do A and D. @raj_infra do B. @emma_eng do C. @sara_cust_success handle external comms.

mike_oncall: Quota request submitted (GCP request id: Q-20260315-9987). ETA customer support says ~90–120m typical.

raj_infra: posting proposed terraform change:```hcl
module "gpu_pool" {
  source = "infra/gpu-pool"
  max_nodes = 30 # temporary emergency bump
}
``` need approval from @anya_sre and infra oncall to apply.

anya_sre: i approve the temporary bump provided we have rollback plan and monitor. @raj_infra go ahead and apply but do not increase actual node count until quota confirmed. this will allow autoscaler to attempt scale when cloud quota is raised.

raj_infra: applying plan now (will not increase nodes without cloud capacity). plan id: plan-4552.

ops-bot: exec: `terraform apply -target=module.gpu_pool` started by raj_infra.

mike_oncall: while that's in flight i'm reducing batch window and pausing non-critical async jobs: `kubectl patch cronjob heavy-batcher -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'` — doing now.

emma_eng: routing change deployed. Non-enterprise traffic now using cpu fallback for heavy models. This should reduce GPU QPS by ~35%. watching queue.

mike_oncall: queue dropping from 1200 -> 780 within 6 minutes. throttle rate improving. still some 5xx spikes for enterprise customers.

sara_cust_success: sent update to top 10 customers: "We're experiencing degraded inference due to capacity constraints; mitigation in progress; estimated recovery 1–2 hours." replies coming in. one enterprise asks for SLA credit; flagged to revenue ops.

raj_infra: terraform change applied (max_nodes=30). note: cloud quota still at 20 so no nodes created above 20 yet.

mike_oncall: update from cloud support: quota request Q-20260315-9987 approved for additional 10 GPUs in region — effective immediately.

mike_oncall: attempting manual increase to node pool min/max to force scale: `gcloud container clusters resize prod-cluster --node-pool inference-prod-gpu --num-nodes 28 --region us-central1`

ops-bot: gcloud: request accepted, provisioning nodes...

mike_oncall: new nodes appearing. pods scheduling. autoscaler reconciling.

anya_sre: monitoring: pod pending count -> 0, queue length -> 120, p95 latency trending down. :thumbsup:

emma_eng: traffic routed back gradually to GPU models for enterprise customers. performing small canary for top 3 contracts.

sara_cust_success: notified customers that capacity increase completed and we are monitoring. asked if anyone still seeing issues.

mike_oncall: final check: GPU nodes = 28, autoscaler healthy, queue draining, error rate back to baseline. closing incident in 10min if stable.

raj_infra: followups: (1) file PR to remove emergency boost and document escalation playbook (2) request permanent quota increase for prod region (3) add automated alert to detect safety-ceiling vs cloud-quota mismatch.

anya_sre: agreed. i'll own the alert and postmortem. mike — can you add timeline to incident ticket?

mike_oncall: adding timeline now. thanks team.

incident-bot: incident resolved: manual scale + routing fallback mitigations completed. incident closed.

ops-bot: pagerduty: incident acknowledged -> resolved by mike_oncall.

sara_cust_success: closing customer follow-up loop, will collate replies and escalate any credit requests.

mike_oncall: good job everyone. postmortem players: mike_oncall, anya_sre, raj_infra, emma_eng, sara_cust_success. leaving notes in #postmortems.

anya_sre: adding retrospective action items now. :wave:
